paper_title: UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection experiment: A precision frequency interferometric axion dark matter search with a Cylindrical Microwave Cavity
notes: Corrected/erratum version of UPLOAD-CMC upconversion axion haloscope. Measured 95% CL exclusion: g_agamma > 3e-3 1/GeV between 7.44-19.38 neV (upconversion) and > 1e-2 1/GeV between 74.4-74.5 ueV (downconversion). Values are the corrected limits after the sign-error erratum. DM density taken as rho_DM = 8e-22 kg/m^3 = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Limits given as flat horizontal bounds over the stated mass ranges.
